summary.verdict_desc: 本周计数 6 红 / 8 黄 / 11 绿，红灯比例连续第 4 期钉在 24.0%、加权风险分维持 40.0%，聚合无一指标发生颜色迁移（动量净 0），两轴与类别分与上周逐位一致（泡沫成熟度 60.0 亢奋 / 破裂临近度 26.7 零星火花；资金面类别分 87.5 仍是唯一破 85 的类别）。头条第四周静止，但内里本周的真正变化是『债务供给端松绑 + 循环融资再加码 + 龙头收入再加速』三件事同时发生，方向彼此矛盾、净额仍未触发档位。① 债务侧：SEC 于 8/10 豁免一大类数据中心证券化交易的关键披露与投资者保护要求，直接给 AI 债供给端松绑——在『AI 债 indigestion』（Bloomberg 8/7 称华尔街开始重新设计发债结构、需求疲劳）的当口，监管反而降低了发行门槛；本周新债以 Jane Street 承租的中俄克拉何马 $2.25B 绿色 DC 债为代表，5 年期定价近 9% 收益率（merchant/greenfield 属性 + 投资者更挑剔的双重体现）。无新 ≥$10B deal，distance to full recon 仅 7 天（上次 8/9），debt_capex_ratio 维持约 55%（50-60%）黄灯。② 循环融资侧：Fortune 8/11 披露 Nvidia 正向华尔街寻求约 $500B 融资承诺（覆盖此前 OpenAI $250B 俄亥俄背书 + $350B 芯片采购融资，叠加 SK $500B 项目），直接股权仍约 $40B/OpenAI $30B 未变，但『Nvidia 背书债务、对方回购 Nvidia 芯片』的闭环从传闻走向落地推进，nvda_invest_revenue 常红 + 二阶继续再扩张。③ 收入侧（本周最重要的新增量信息）：Bloomberg 8/13-14 报 OpenAI 年化 run rate 破 $40B（较 2025 底约 $20B 翻倍），总裁 Brockman 内部信称 7 月单月 run rate 环比 +20%——OpenAI 明确再加速；但 ARR 更大的 Anthropic（约 $74.1B）月增量已回落至 +$4.5B（前 +$17B）、二阶导仍负，两家一加一减混合，arr_2nd_deriv 维持『平稳/黄』不变。宏观：fed_policy 维持黄灯但边际续偏鹰——9/16 会议 CME FedWatch 隐含『维持』概率由上周约 60% 收敛至约 50%（8/12，Motley Fool/centralbank.watch 口径），加息与维持近乎五五开，油价通胀 + 8/12 CPI 令曲线整体不敢言鸽，虽未达『隐含加息=红』门槛（模态仍是维持）但为全期最接近红线的一次；accounting_events 维持绿，但 SEC 于 8/5 新设『财报与会计执法单元』并计划以 AI 扫描全部上市公司备案——尚无 AI 专项立案，属需盯的宏观软信号。估值端 melt-up 续行：CAPE 约 41.5（GuruFocus 42.18、MacroRadar 41.18、多源 41-42），逼近 2000 峰值 44.2、150 年 98.9 分位；S&P 前 5 权重约 28%（NVDA 7.74% 为史上最大 S&P 单一权重、AAPL 7.04%、MSFT 6.87%）、前 10 约 37.7% 续处纪录；唯 NVDA 远期 PE 约 24x（GuruFocus 25.17）维持绿灯、较半导体中位数约 31 折价。市场结构：广度由上周约 62% 随 melt-up（S&P 收 7785.76、连三周涨、VIX 约 14.85 多月低位）回升至约 66%（8/7 现值 65.6%，周五 8/14 UMich 情绪走弱小幅回落），守绿；内部人卖压维持红灯，openinsider 连续第 5 周 egress 受限，NVDA 90 日 13 笔全为卖出约 $767M（黄仁勋 8/6、8/8 各减 7.5 万股约 $27M）、买盘归零，约 25x 为方向性估算——连续第 5 期同值且始终拿不到 12 家聚合美元总额，维持 suspect_static、需人工核查。信用面仍是最强支撑（类别分 25.0）：宽口径 HY OAS 约 271bps（Convex 8/12 271、TradingEconomics 272，环比基本持平，续处最紧十分位，绿）；neocloud 维持黄灯（CoreWeave CDS 仍约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，90 日内仍无已确认降级/违约）。基本面维持类别分 8.3：token 绝对量本周仍无 fresh 独立读（openrouter/rankings 仍不可得，沿用约 100-125T/月，行业无收缩迹象但 freshness 告警加深）、GPU 现货 firm（H100 on-demand 约 $2.19-2.69、median $4.47/YoY +28%、无过剩）、云 RPO 强劲加速、前沿进展仍加速（近两周多为中国开源前沿 GLM-5.3/Qwen3.8 刷新，无 2 季停滞）。判读：基础档位按 red_pct 24.0%（<25）本落观察期，但估值 2 红（CAPE、Top-5）叠加资金面 3 红（FCF、VC AI 占比、NVDA 客户投资）触发估值 + 资金面双类共振强制升级，维持高风险预警；两轴升级（stage≥60 且 trigger≥50）因 trigger 仅 26.7 未触发。历史相似度：本期颜色向量与上周逐位一致，最像 2000-02（顶前 1 个月，76%），次 1999-06（70%）、2021-11（68%），2007-10（41%）最不像。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）向量的主要差异（即接下来确认进入顶部前夜要盯的信号）：NVDA 远期 PE 仍便宜（约 24x vs 2000 龙头约 60x）、市场广度仍绿（约 66%）、宽口径 HY 信用仍紧（271bps vs 2000 走阔）、IPO 未成洪流（Anthropic 公开 S-1 至中 8 月仍未出、瞄准 9-10 月，OpenAI 倾向 2027）、Fed 为维持而非明确加息——本周这些差异中收窄最快的仍是 Fed（维持概率已滑向五五开）与循环融资/债务供给（Nvidia $500B 融资承诺、SEC 证券化松绑）。分母提醒：N=25 下 6 红对应 24.0%，跨期趋势以方向为主。一句话：头条第四周钉在 24%，但这份静止下本周同时发生了三件互相矛盾的事——监管给 AI 债供给松绑（SEC 证券化豁免）、Nvidia 循环融资从 $250B 扩到向华尔街要 $500B、OpenAI 收入再加速破 $40B run rate；真正在积累的不是红灯数量，而是『用更松的债 + 更绕的融资去支撑一个确实还在加速的收入曲线』这一组合的内在张力，以及 Fed 维持概率滑向五五开。（动量净 0，无色变，未及 ±4 阈值。）
summary.verdict_desc_en: This week prints 6 red / 8 yellow / 11 green, with the red share pinned at 24.0% for a fourth straight reading and the weighted risk score holding at 40.0% — not a single indicator changed color (net momentum 0), and the two axes and category scores match last week digit-for-digit (bubble maturity 60.0 Euphoria / rupture proximity 26.7 Sparks; capital is still the only category above 85, at 87.5). The headline is frozen for a fourth week, but the real move underneath was three things happening at once, pointing in contradictory directions and netting to no re-rating: (1) On the debt-supply side, the SEC on Aug 10 exempted a large subset of data-center securitizations from key disclosure and investor-protection requirements — loosening AI-debt supply just as 'AI debt indigestion' (Bloomberg, Aug 7: Wall Street rethinking bond structures amid demand fatigue) set in, so the regulator lowered the bar exactly when investors were pulling back; this week's marquee new issue was a Jane Street-leased $2.25B green data-center bond in Central Oklahoma priced to yield almost 9% over five years (a merchant/greenfield profile plus pickier investors). No new >=$10B deal, only 7 days since the last full reconciliation (Aug 9), so debt_capex_ratio stays ~55% (50-60% range), yellow. (2) On the circular-financing side, Fortune reported Aug 11 that Nvidia is seeking a ~$500B funding commitment from Wall Street (covering the earlier $250B OpenAI Ohio backstop plus ~$350B of chip-purchase financing, on top of the $500B SK Group project); direct equity stays ~$40B (OpenAI $30B), but the 'Nvidia backstops the debt, the counterparty buys Nvidia silicon' loop is moving from rumor to execution, keeping nvda_invest_revenue a persistent red with a still-re-expanding second order. (3) On the revenue side (the week's most important new information), Bloomberg reported Aug 13-14 that OpenAI's annualized run rate topped $40B (roughly double the ~$20B at end-2025), with President Brockman telling staff the monthly run rate grew more than 20% in July alone — OpenAI is clearly re-accelerating; but Anthropic, the larger ARR name (~$74.1B), has seen its monthly increment ease to +$4.5B (from +$17B) with a still-negative second derivative, so the two offset and arr_2nd_deriv stays 'flat/yellow.' Macro: fed_policy holds yellow but keeps drifting hawkish — the Sept 16 meeting's CME FedWatch 'hold' probability narrowed from ~60% last week to ~50% (Aug 12, Motley Fool/centralbank.watch), hike and hold now near a coin flip, with oil-driven inflation and the Aug 12 CPI leaving the curve unwilling to turn dovish; it is short of 'implied hike = red' (the modal outcome is still a hold) but is the closest to the red line all run. accounting_events stays green, but the SEC on Aug 5 stood up a new Financial Reporting and Accounting Enforcement Unit and plans to use AI to scan every public filing — no AI-specific case yet, a macro soft signal to watch. Valuations keep melting up: CAPE ~41.5 (GuruFocus 42.18, MacroRadar 41.18, multiple sources 41-42), nearing the 2000 peak of 44.2 at the 98.9th percentile in 150 years; the S&P Top-5 weight is ~28% (NVDA 7.74% — the largest single S&P weight ever, AAPL 7.04%, MSFT 6.87%), Top-10 ~37.7% at a record; only NVDA's ~24x forward PE (GuruFocus 25.17) stays green, a discount to the ~31 semiconductor median. Market structure: breadth firmed from ~62% to ~66% on the melt-up (S&P closed 7,785.76, a third straight weekly gain, VIX ~14.85 at multi-month lows; the Aug 7 live read was 65.6%, with a small Friday-Aug-14 pullback on weak Michigan sentiment), staying green; insider selling stays red, with openinsider egress-blocked for a fifth straight week — NVDA's 13 trailing-90-day transactions were all sales (~$767M; Huang sold 75k shares each on Aug 6 and Aug 8, ~$27M) with buying at zero, so ~25x is a directional estimate (a fifth straight identical value with the 12-name aggregate still unobtainable), flagged suspect-static, pending manual review. Credit remains the strongest support (category 25.0): broad HY OAS ~271bps (Convex 271 on Aug 12, TradingEconomics 272, roughly flat, still tightest-decile, green); neocloud holds yellow (CoreWeave CDS still ~855bps, ~50% implied default probability, no confirmed downgrade or default in 90 days). Fundamentals hold at category 8.3: no fresh independent token read again this week (openrouter.ai/rankings still unavailable, carrying ~100-125T/month with no sign of contraction but a deepening freshness caveat), GPU spot firm (H100 on-demand ~$2.19-2.69, median $4.47, +28% YoY, no glut), cloud RPO strong and accelerating, and frontier progress still accelerating (the last two weeks' releases are mostly Chinese open frontier models, GLM-5.3/Qwen3.8, with no two-quarter stall). Verdict: the base framework sits at Observation on red_pct of 24.0% (<25), but valuation 2-red (CAPE, Top-5) plus capital 3-red (FCF, VC AI share, NVDA customer-financing) fire the dual-category resonance override, holding the verdict at High Risk Alert; the two-axis upgrade (stage>=60 and trigger>=50) does not fire because trigger is only 26.7. Historical similarity: the color vector is identical to last week, most resembling February 2000 (one month before the top, 76%), then June 1999 (70%) and November 2021 (68%), with October 2007 (41%) least alike. The main differences versus the February 2000 vector — the signals to watch to confirm entry into the top's eve — are: NVDA's forward PE still cheap (~24x vs ~60x for 2000's leaders), market breadth still green (~66%), broad HY credit still tight (271bps vs widening in 2000), the IPO pipeline not yet a flood (Anthropic's public S-1 still not out by mid-August, targeting Sept-Oct; OpenAI leans 2027), and the Fed holding rather than clearly hiking — among these, the fastest-narrowing gaps remain the Fed (hold probability sliding toward a coin flip) and circular-financing/debt-supply (Nvidia's $500B funding ask, the SEC's securitization easing). Denominator reminder: with N=25 the six reds map to 24.0%, so cross-period trend comparison should lean on direction. In one line: the headline is pinned at 24% for a fourth week, but underneath, three contradictory things happened at once — the regulator loosened AI-debt supply (SEC securitization exemption), Nvidia's circular financing scaled from $250B to a $500B Wall Street ask, and OpenAI's revenue re-accelerated past a $40B run rate; what is actually accumulating is the internal tension of 'looser debt plus more convoluted financing propping up a revenue curve that is genuinely still accelerating,' along with the Fed's hold probability sliding toward a coin flip. (Net momentum 0, no color changes, below the +/-4 threshold.)

wow_changes.note_en: The Fed curve keeps drifting hawkish at the margin: the CME FedWatch 'hold' probability for the Sept 16 meeting narrowed from ~60% last week to ~50% (Aug 12), with hike and hold now near a coin flip; oil-driven inflation plus the Aug 12 CPI leave the curve unwilling to turn dovish. The modal outcome is still a hold (short of 'implied hike = red'), but it is the closest to the red line all run — stays yellow

wow_changes.to: SEC 新设财报会计执法单元 (8/5)
wow_changes.note: 需盯的宏观软信号：SEC 8/5 新设「财报与会计执法单元」、将财务报告列为前三大执法优先项，并计划用 AI 扫描全部上市公司备案掘风险。尚无 AI 龙头专项立案、无确认事件，维持绿灯；但在循环融资/round-tripping 议论升温的背景下，监管工具箱的强化值得追踪
wow_changes.note_en: A macro soft signal to watch: the SEC on Aug 5 stood up a new Financial Reporting and Accounting Enforcement Unit, listed financial reporting among its top three enforcement priorities, and plans to use AI to scan every public filing for emerging risk. No AI-specific case or confirmed event yet, so this stays green; but against a backdrop of escalating circular-financing/round-tripping commentary, the buildout of the regulator's toolkit is worth tracking

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20%~0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: Q2 已全部落地、本周无新披露，沿用台账：Meta Q2 FCF $784M（同比约 -91%）、Amazon TTM FCF 转负 -$7.6B、Alphabet Q2 -$5.855B；仅 MSFT 仍正 $19.6B。Mag4 多数由造现金转向吞现金、需外部融资，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: Q2 has fully landed with no new disclosure this week, carrying the ledger: Meta Q2 FCF $784M (~-91% YoY), Amazon TTM FCF negative -$7.6B, Alphabet Q2 -$5.855B; only MSFT stays positive at $19.6B. Most of the Mag4 have shifted from generating to consuming cash, leaning on external financing — red

indicators.name_zh: AI 占 VC 投资比重
indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 沿用 PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 硬数据（仍为最新，无新 Q3 披露）：AI 占全球创投超 70%（一年前不足 50%）、占美国创投 86%（$355.9B）；H1 全球创投创纪录 $510B、OpenAI+Anthropic 两家占 43%（$217B）。美元高度集中于少数巨额轮次，远超 50% 红线，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 hard data is carried (still the freshest; no new Q3 print): AI took >70% of global VC (from under 50% a year ago) and 86% of US VC ($355.9B); record H1 global VC of $510B, with OpenAI and Anthropic alone at 43% ($217B). Dollars concentrate in a few mega-rounds far above the 50% red line — red

indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green (Lucent '99 peak: 24%)
indicators.note: 常红处理，二阶继续再扩张：直接股权承诺仍约 $40B（OpenAI $30B）占约 $300B LTM 收入远超 Lucent 1999 峰值 24%；Fortune 8/11 披露 Nvidia 正向华尔街寻求约 $500B 融资承诺（覆盖 OpenAI $250B 俄亥俄背书 + $350B 芯片采购融资，叠加 SK $500B 项目）——「Nvidia 背书债务、对方回购芯片」闭环由传闻走向落地，循环融资口实升级，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: A persistent red with a still-re-expanding second order: direct equity commitments remain ~$40B (OpenAI $30B) against ~$300B LTM revenue, far above Lucent's 1999 peak of 24%; Fortune reported Aug 11 that Nvidia is seeking a ~$500B funding commitment from Wall Street (covering the OpenAI $250B Ohio backstop plus ~$350B of chip financing, on top of the $500B SK Group project) — the 'Nvidia backstops the debt, the counterparty buys the chips' loop is moving from rumor to execution, escalating the circular-financing critique — red

indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: 广度随 melt-up 回firm：S5FI 现值 8/7 读 65.6%，本周市场创记录新高（S&P 收 7785.76、连三周涨、VIX 约 14.85 多月低位）后周五 8/14 因 UMich 情绪走弱小幅回落，估 end-of-week 约 66%，较上周约 62% 回升、守绿。头部与广度同向、暂无 2000 式头部独撑（barchart/investing 实时源仍受限，取二手读+估算）
indicators.note_en: Breadth re-firmed with the melt-up: the live S5FI read 65.6% on Aug 7; the market made fresh record highs this week (S&P closed 7,785.76, a third straight weekly gain, VIX ~14.85 at multi-month lows) before a small Friday-Aug-14 pullback on weak Michigan sentiment, so ~66% is estimated end-of-week, up from ~62% last week and holding green. Index and breadth move together with no 2000-style narrow leadership (Barchart/Investing live sources still limited; secondary reads plus estimate used)

indicators.name_zh: AI 龙头内部人卖买比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >20x = red / 5-20x = yellow / <5x = green (2000 peak: 23x)
indicators.note: 内部人卖压维持红灯，数据源连续第 5 周不可用：openinsider 仍 egress 受限（curl CONNECT 与 WebFetch 均 403），12 家 30 日聚合卖/买美元比仍无法精确获取。具名数据点：NVDA 90 日 13 笔全为卖出约 $767M（黄仁勋 8/6、8/8 各减 7.5 万股约 $13.4M/$13.7M）、15 名内部人 18 月零买入，买盘归零使比值远超 20x，25x 为方向性估算——连续 5 期同值且始终拿不到聚合美元总额，标记 suspect_static、需人工核查
indicators.note_en: Insider selling stays red, with the data source unavailable for a fifth straight week: openinsider remained egress-blocked (both curl CONNECT and WebFetch 403), so the 12-name 30-day aggregate dollar ratio still cannot be obtained precisely. Named data points: NVDA's 13 trailing-90-day transactions were all sales (~$767M; Huang sold 75k shares each on Aug 6 and Aug 8, ~$13.4M/$13.7M) with 15 insiders showing zero purchases over 18 months; near-zero buying keeps the ratio well above 20x, and 25x is a directional estimate — a fifth straight identical value with the aggregate dollar total still unobtainable, so it is flagged suspect-static and needs manual review

indicators.threshold_text: 洪流=红 / 升温=黄 / 平静=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood = red / Warming = yellow / Quiet = green
indicators.note: 管道继续升温但未成洪流：Anthropic 领跑——6/1 交表、承销商 GS/JPM/MS 持续排会，瞄准 9 月公开 S-1、9-10 月初路演、10 月首挂（或成首家 $1T 估值 IPO），但至中 8 月公开 S-1 仍未释出。OpenAI（run rate 破 $40B「ahead of IPO」传闻升温、约 $920B 保密交表）仍倾向 2027。本周无全新 AI IPO/SPAC 公告，临近发行（6 个月内）实质仍只 Anthropic、总数 <10，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: The pipeline keeps warming but is short of a flood: Anthropic leads — filed June 1, its bankers (GS/JPM/MS) keep scheduling meetings, targeting a public S-1 in September, a roadshow in September-early October and a first trade in October (potentially the first $1T-valuation IPO), though the public S-1 was still not out by mid-August. OpenAI (run rate topping $40B amid 'ahead of IPO' chatter, confidential filing at ~$920B) still leans toward 2027. No brand-new AI IPO/SPAC announcement this week, and imminent (within-6-month) names are still essentially just Anthropic, under 10 total — yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: ICE BofA HY OAS 约 271bps（Convex 8/12 271、TradingEconomics 272），环比基本持平（上周 271），仍远低于长期均值约 394bps、中位数约 452bps，处历史最紧十分位。宽口径信用对 AI 风险仍无压力、是当前最支撑多头的指标，维持绿灯（但要害处 AI/DC 高收益债与 merchant DC 债自 6 月起走阔的分层背离仍需并读）
indicators.note_en: ICE BofA HY OAS is ~271bps (Convex 271 on Aug 12, TradingEconomics 272), roughly flat versus last week's 271 and still far below the ~394bps average and ~452bps median, in the historically tightest decile. Broad credit shows no stress on AI risk and is the most bull-supportive indicator now — green (but read alongside the tiering divergence: AI/DC high-yield and merchant DC bonds have widened since June)

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ = 红 / 稳定 = 黄 / 收窄 = 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widening 50bps+ = red / Stable = yellow / Tightening = green
indicators.note: AAA 级 DC ABS 侧仍最紧：KBRA 续给新发预评级（DataBank 2026-1 等），SEC 8/10 豁免一大类 DC 证券化的关键披露与投资者保护要求、直接给供给端松绑。基准 AAA 利差未现 50bps+ 走阔，维持绿灯——但须并记边际应力：本周 Jane Street 承租的 $2.25B 绿色 DC 债 5 年期定价近 9%（merchant/greenfield），且「AI 债 indigestion」使华尔街重新设计发债结构，DC 债复合体成本端应力在累积
indicators.note_en: The AAA data-center ABS side stays tightest: KBRA keeps rating new issues (DataBank 2026-1 and others), and the SEC on Aug 10 exempted a large subset of DC securitizations from key disclosure and investor-protection rules, directly easing supply. Benchmark AAA spreads show no 50bps+ widening — green, but note the marginal strain: this week's Jane Street-leased $2.25B green DC bond priced to yield almost 9% over five years (merchant/greenfield), and 'AI debt indigestion' has Wall Street rethinking bond structures, so cost strain is accumulating across the DC-debt complex

indicators.threshold_text: 任何违约/降级=红 / Watch=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any default/downgrade = red / Watch = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯（观察）：CoreWeave 5 年期 CDS 仍约 855bps、隐含约 50% 违约概率，月内股价 -36%、Nebius -43%；Q1 利息支出翻倍至 $536M、FCF -$47.1 亿、债务本金 $251 亿。反向：Nebius 现金 $93.7 亿、流动性稳，S&P 前将 CoreWeave 展望调至正面。本周无新增已确认降级/违约，90 日门槛未破，但 CDS 定价 + 深度回撤维持『观察』，为信用轴持续冒烟的火星
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow (Watch): CoreWeave's 5-year CDS is still ~855bps, implying ~50% default probability, with the stock down 36% on the month and Nebius -43%; Q1 interest expense doubled to $536M, FCF was -$4.71B and debt principal $25.1B. Countervailing: Nebius holds $9.37B cash with stable liquidity, and S&P earlier revised CoreWeave's outlook to Positive. No new confirmed downgrade or default this week and the 90-day threshold is intact, but the CDS pricing plus deep drawdowns keep the 'watch' — the credit axis keeps smoking

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >=70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green (dot-com peak: 80-100%)
indicators.note: 周度增量台账（距上次 8/9 完整对账仅 7 天、未到 28 天）：分子维持 MS 全口径 2026E 新增 AI 债务约 $570B、分母全口径 capex 约 $1.04T，比值约 55%（区间 50-60%），维持黄灯。本周边际：+$2.25B Jane Street 承租的绿色 DC 债（5yr 近 9%），无新 ≥$10B deal；供给端 SEC 8/10 豁免一大类 DC 证券化披露规则（利好发行），需求端「AI 债 indigestion」使华尔街重新设计发债结构——供需两侧同时活动、净额未改锚定
indicators.note_en: Weekly incremental ledger (only 7 days since the Aug 9 full reconciliation, short of 28): numerator holds at MS's all-in 2026E new AI debt ~$570B over ~$1.04T of all-in capex, giving ~55% (50-60% range) — stays yellow. This week's margin: +$2.25B for the Jane Street-leased green DC bond (5-year, ~9%), with no new >=$10B deal; on supply the SEC on Aug 10 exempted a large subset of DC securitizations from disclosure rules (issuance-friendly), while on demand 'AI debt indigestion' has Wall Street rethinking bond structures — both sides active, the anchor unchanged
indicators.source_name: Morgan Stanley + 自下而上台账

indicators.name_zh: AI 行业 Token 月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contraction = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 本周仍未获全新独立月度绝对量读数：openrouter.ai/rankings 仍不可得，可得口径仍为约 25T/周、1.5 quadrillion/年、8M 用户（5-7 月披露），沿用约 100-125T/月量级、环比按持平估。交叉印证行业无收缩：OpenAI 7 月 run rate MoM +20%、Anthropic 续增。维持绿灯——但 freshness 告警加深（绝对量数据已约 10-12 周旧），若下期仍无 fresh read 将逼近静态预警
indicators.note_en: Still no fresh independent monthly absolute read this week: openrouter.ai/rankings remains unavailable, and the available figures stay ~25T/week, a ~1.5-quadrillion annual run-rate and 8M users (May-July disclosures), so the ~100-125T/month level is carried with a flat MoM estimate. Cross-checks confirm no contraction: OpenAI's July run rate grew +20% MoM and Anthropic keeps growing. Stays green — but the freshness caveat deepens (the absolute data is now ~10-12 weeks old), and another missing figure next period would approach a static-value warning

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌>15%/供过于求=红 / 阴跌=黄 / 稳定或上涨=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: -15%+ MoM / glut = red / Drifting lower = yellow / Stable-to-rising = green
indicators.note: 供需温度计仍偏紧：H100 on-demand 约 $2.19-2.69（Jarvis $2.69）、spot 约 $1-2，H200 on-demand 约 $3.99/spot 约 $1.99；跨提供商 median on-demand 约 $4.47、较去年同期 +28%。无广泛过剩，算力商品价格最直接温度计维持 firm、绿灯（Blackwell 放量仍为下期需盯的软信号）
indicators.note_en: The supply-demand thermometer stays tight: H100 on-demand ~$2.19-2.69 (Jarvis $2.69) and spot ~$1-2, H200 on-demand ~$3.99 / spot ~$1.99; the cross-provider median on-demand is ~$4.47, up ~28% YoY. No broad glut, so the most direct compute-price gauge stays firm and green (a Blackwell ramp remains a soft signal to watch next period)

indicators.name_zh: AI 收入增速的二阶导
indicators.threshold_text: 减速=红 / 平稳=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decel = red / Flat = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 本周有新披露、判定不变：Bloomberg 8/13-14 报 OpenAI 年化 run rate 破 $40B（较 2025 底约 $20B 翻倍），总裁 Brockman 称 7 月单月 run rate 环比 +20%——明确再加速；但 ARR 更大的 Anthropic（约 $74.1B）月增量已回落至 +$4.5B（前 +$17B）、二阶导仍负。两家一加一减混合，维持『平稳/黄』（Anthropic 作为 run-rate 领先者的减速仍是主要拖累）
indicators.note_en: There is new disclosure this week but the read is unchanged: Bloomberg reported Aug 13-14 that OpenAI's annualized run rate topped $40B (roughly double the ~$20B at end-2025), with President Brockman saying the July monthly run rate grew +20% MoM — a clear re-acceleration; but Anthropic, the larger ARR name (~$74.1B), has slowed to a +$4.5B monthly increment (from +$17B) with a still-negative second derivative. The two offset, so the read stays 'flat / yellow' (Anthropic's deceleration as run-rate leader remains the main drag)

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: McKinsey Q1 2026：72% 企业至少 1 项 AI workload 生产化（2024 为 55%、2020 为 20%）。季度调查、本周无新 Q2/Q3 整体生产化读数，沿用 Q1；佐证：约 31% 企业已有 ≥1 个 AI agent 进入生产、约 28% 规模化。头部部署率高位、维持绿灯（Q2/Q3 整体调查待发布）
indicators.note_en: McKinsey Q1 2026: 72% of enterprises run at least one AI workload in production (vs 55% in 2024, 20% in 2020). It is a quarterly survey with no new Q2/Q3 overall print this week, so Q1 is carried; supporting data show ~31% with at least one AI agent in production and ~28% at scale. The headline rate stays high — green (the Q2/Q3 overall survey pending)

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 订单积压维持纪录、加速（Q2 数据、本周无新披露）：MSFT 商业 RPO $678B（+84% YoY）、Amazon RPO $496B（环比 +$132B）、Google 积压 $514B、Oracle RPO $638B，大三 hyperscaler 积压合计约 $1.69T。订单强劲且加速，维持绿灯（Oracle 客户集中于 OpenAI 仍为结构性隐患）
indicators.note_en: Backlogs stay at records and accelerating (Q2 data, no new disclosure this week): MSFT commercial RPO $678B (+84% YoY), Amazon RPO $496B (+$132B sequentially), Google's $514B backlog and Oracle's $638B RPO put big-3 hyperscaler backlog at ~$1.69T. The order book is strong and accelerating — green (Oracle's concentration in OpenAI remains a structural risk)

indicators.threshold_text: 停滞=红 / 放缓=黄 / 正常或加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Stalled = red / Decelerating = yellow / On-trend or accelerating = green
indicators.note: 前沿进展仍在轨：困难基准数月内饱和、HLE 一年 +30pp（SOTA 约 53.3%）、SWE-bench Pro 约 80.3%；METR 倍增约 4 月轨道未放缓。近两周新发多为中国开源前沿（GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8 均 8/14），西方旗舰无新代际 SOTA 跳升但亦无 2 季停滞（近月 Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6、Grok 4.5 密集）。capex 第一性支撑（模型持续变好解锁场景）完好，对台账上期无实质放缓，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: Frontier progress stays on-trend: hard benchmarks saturate within months, HLE gained +30pp in a year (SOTA ~53.3%) and SWE-bench Pro is ~80.3%; METR's doubling holds a ~4-month track. The last two weeks' releases are mostly Chinese open frontier models (GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8, both Aug 14), with Western flagships showing no new generational SOTA jump but no two-quarter stall either (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 and Grok 4.5 clustered in recent months). The first-principles support for capex (models keep improving, unlocking use cases) is intact with no material slowdown versus the prior ledger — green

indicators.threshold_text: 任何=红 / 调查=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any confirmed = red / Investigation = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 本周核心 AI 龙头仍无新增正式执法、无确认事件，维持绿灯；但需盯的宏观软信号升级：SEC 8/5 新设『财报与会计执法单元』（Timothy Zimmerman 领衔）、将财务报告列为前三大执法优先项，并计划用 AI 扫描全部上市公司备案掘风险。现有 round-tripping（Nvidia→OpenAI→CoreWeave/Oracle）仍属分析师/批评者审视、无 AI 专项立案，但监管工具箱强化叠加 Nvidia $500B 融资承诺，round-tripping 议论量继续升温
indicators.note_en: No new formal enforcement against a core AI bellwether and no confirmed event this week, so it stays green; but the macro soft signal to watch escalated: the SEC on Aug 5 stood up a new Financial Reporting and Accounting Enforcement Unit (led by Timothy Zimmerman), listed financial reporting among its top three priorities, and plans to use AI to scan every public filing for risk. Existing round-tripping (Nvidia->OpenAI->CoreWeave/Oracle) remains analyst/critic scrutiny with no AI-specific probe, but the reinforced regulatory toolkit plus Nvidia's $500B funding ask keeps round-tripping commentary intensifying

indicators.threshold_text: 加息=红 / 通胀压力=黄 / 降息=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike = red / Inflation pressure = yellow / Cut = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯，但边际续偏鹰、为全期最接近红线的一次：9/16 会议 CME FedWatch 隐含『维持』概率由上周约 60% 收敛至约 50%（8/12，Motley Fool/centralbank.watch），加息与维持近乎五五开；油价通胀 + 8/12 CPI 令曲线整体不敢言鸽。模态仍是维持（未达『隐含加息=红』门槛），故未改判红；但『维持』概率滑向五五开是黄区内明确的边际恶化，也是与 2000-02 向量收窄最快的差异之一
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow, but keeps drifting hawkish at the margin and is the closest to the red line all run: the CME FedWatch 'hold' probability for the Sept 16 meeting narrowed from ~60% last week to ~50% (Aug 12, Motley Fool/centralbank.watch), with hike and hold near a coin flip; oil-driven inflation plus the Aug 12 CPI leave the curve unwilling to turn dovish. The modal outcome is still a hold (short of 'implied hike = red'), so no re-rating to red; but the 'hold' probability sliding toward a coin flip is a clear marginal deterioration within the yellow band, and one of the fastest-narrowing gaps versus the February 2000 vector

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚=红 / 偶发=黄 / 奖励=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment = red / Episodic = yellow / Rewarded = green
indicators.note: 维持黄灯：Q2 财报季已结束、本周无新 capex 指引反应可读，沿用上期『选择性/偶发惩罚』判定——市场奖励有需求佐证的 capex（MSFT/Amazon）、只惩罚烧现金无对价者（Meta）。反应函数处红黄之间，Nvidia 8/27 财报为下一读点，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Stays yellow: Q2 season is over with no new capex-guidance reaction to read this week, carrying the prior 'selective/episodic punishment' call — the market rewarded capex backed by demand (MSFT/Amazon) and punished only cash-burning capex without receipts (Meta). The reaction function sits between red and yellow; Nvidia's Aug 27 print is the next read — yellow

indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热=红 / 部分=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widespread acknowledgment = red / Partial = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 对冲表态持续但未成一致：Sam Altman 本月对 The Verge 重申『投资者整体对 AI 过度兴奋』、被问是否泡沫答『是』，但长期框定为净赢；反向 Jensen Huang 直接驳斥泡沫论、称 OpenAI『很可能成为下一家数万亿美元超大规模公司』、『通用计算已终结』；Pichai 续看多。各家仍集体加码 capex、无一在承认过热同时收缩支出，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Hedging continues but is not universal: Sam Altman told The Verge this month that 'investors as a whole are overexcited about AI' and said 'yes' when asked if it is a bubble, while framing the long term as a net win; conversely Jensen Huang flatly dismissed bubble talk, calling OpenAI 'very likely the world's next multitrillion-dollar hyperscaler' and declaring 'general-purpose computing is over'; Pichai stays bullish. All majors keep raising capex and none is conceding an overheated market while cutting spend — yellow
